@@U02354@@
One of us ended under the table,
So keep your seat as long as you're able!

@@U02355@@
(Enter the GRACES.)

@@U02357@@
Into living we bring grace!
In your giving give it place!

@@U02359@@
In receiving grace retain!
Sweet it is a wish to gain.

@@U02361@@
And in days of thoughtful mood,
Let grace sweeten gratitude.

@@U02363@@
Everyone! Please! To one side!
What approaches now is not of your kind!
Behold a mountainous beast,
hung with rich, bright tapestries,
two tusks in its head and a snakelike trunk.
What a mystery!
Ah, but I have it!
I have the key!
On his neck a delicate woman
guides him with a slender staff.
And on his back in a towering structure
another one, glorious, exalted,
whose dazzling radiance all but blinds me.
Beside the beast are two women in chains;
one of them fearful, the other glad;
one of them hoping to be free,
the other believing herself free.
Let each now tell us who she is.

@@U02364@@
(Enter 佐伊洛斯忒耳西忒斯.)
translation:
@@U02354@@
我们中的一个人在桌子底下结束，
因此，只要有能力，就尽量保留座位！

@@U02355@@
（恩典上。）

@@U02357@@
我们将恩典带入生活！
在你的奉献中给它一席之地！

@@U02359@@
在接受恩典中保留！
甜蜜是一种获得的愿望。

@@U02361@@
而在心情沉思的日子里，
让恩典让感恩变得甜蜜。

@@U02363@@
大家！请！到一侧！
现在接近的不是你们的同类！
瞧一头山兽，
挂着丰富、明亮的挂毯，
它的头上有两根獠牙，还有一条像蛇一样的躯干。
多么神秘啊！
啊，但是我有！
我有钥匙！
他脖子上挂着一个娇柔的女人
用细长的手杖引导他。
在他的背上，有一座高耸的建筑
另一位，光荣的，崇高的，
其耀眼的光芒几乎让我失明。
野兽旁边有两个戴着铁链的女人。
他们一个害怕，另一个高兴；
其中一人希望获得自由，
另一个相信自己自由了。
现在让每个人都告诉我们她是谁。

@@U02364@@
（佐伊洛斯·忒耳西·忒斯上。）
